sites.name: Site name
sites.warningDeltaHelp:
Optional buffer added outside the normal min/max band. Readings beyond the normal range but still inside this buffer trigger a warning alert. Leave empty to skip this step (readings outside normal min/max alone still warn).

Example: normal 6.5–7.5 with critical delta 0.5 → critical below 6.0 or above 8.0.
sites.criticalDeltaHelp:
Optional buffer beyond the warning band. Readings outside normal min/max by more than this amount trigger a critical alert. Should be ≥ warning delta when both are set. Leave empty to skip critical range checks.

Example: normal 6.5–7.5 with critical delta 1 → critical below 5.5 or above 8.5.
